description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of the website.

> A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

description.zh:
筛选规则来源。取值：
- **manual**（默认）：手动添加
- **clover**：自动生成
description.en:
The source of the rule. Valid values:

- **manual** (default): The rule is manually created.

- **clover**: The rule is automatically generated.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询网站业务精确访问控制规则

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-precise-access-rule --resource-group-id default --domains www.test0000.com --owner manual --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo DescribeWebPreciseAccessRule --region cn-hangzhou --Owner manual --ResourceGroupId default --Domains.1 'www.test0000.com'
